prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, Lost and Unmissed. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Terracotta, faded mustard and sage, the warm and slightly worn palette of a small municipal counter. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Male-read lone glove seeking its partner. upright narrow droplet, wistful gaze, pressed lower lip. One compact cue: oversized soft mitten used as an open cap with face wholly visible.
2. Female-read keeper of lost umbrellas. wide scalloped splat, attentive side-eye, knowing closed smile. One compact cue: small closed umbrella with three keys tied neatly to its handle.
3. Male-read visitor inventing a loss at the counter. broad lopsided blob, lifted eyebrows, uneasy smile. One compact cue: blank claim slip and pencil poised to improvise.
4. Female-read clerk matching lost-property tags. tall soft comma, tense gaze and tight mouth. One compact cue: two large plain color tags linked to a small cloth parcel.
5. Male-read minor-object attendant. squat bean, proud lifted eyes, tiny grin. One compact cue: small compartmented tray holding a button and a thimble.
6. Male-read forever-unclaimed suitcase custodian. round droop, weary lids and flat mouth. One compact cue: tiny scuffed suitcase with one large paper tag.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.
